curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the work zone speed law, where a zone begins and ends, added penalties, orange signs and flaggers, acting early on advance signs, rear-end risk from slow driving, and control devices.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for zone limits versus the penalty sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on work zone rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover when headlights are required, low and high beam use, night risks, dimming reminders, glare, speed at night, parking at night, and sun glare.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the two headlight triggers and the dimming reminder.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on headlight law and night driving.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain headlights and wipers in rain, longer stopping and following distances, when roads are slickest, slower wet-road speed, and cruise control.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for stopping versus following multipliers and cruise control timing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define hydroplaning and when it starts, how to respond, tire condition, signs of standing water, and lingering puddles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for speed, depth and response.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover flood deaths, never driving into standing water, water depths that move cars, and what to do in thick versus drivable fog.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the two water depths and the two fog responses.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on floods and fog.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach where freezing starts, snowstorm speeds, gentle starts and testing grip, stopping distance and engine braking, and the limits of chains and snow tires.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for stopping distance and engine braking.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain slowing and scanning, survival at lower speed, when animals are active, high beam use, groups of deer, and what to do when an animal is in the road.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for high beam use.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on avoiding wildlife collisions.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec12-m01..sec12-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
